About The Role Peraton is seeking a Tier 1 Service Desk Technician to join our team of qualified and diverse individuals. The Tier 1 Service Desk Technician provides first-contact end-user support through OST's centralized Service Desk, serving as the primary point of contact for approximately 900 Federal and contractor personnel. This role is responsible for logging, tracking, troubleshooting, and resolving service requests and incidents while delivering exceptional customer service. The Service Desk Technician supports onboarding activities, performs routine account administration, and escalates complex issues to senior technical staff and operations teams in accordance with IT service management and ITIL best practices. Location: Albuquerque, NM Day to Day Roles and Responsibilities: Log, categorize, prioritize, and manage service requests and incidents received through ServiceNow, email, chat, and telephone communications. Perform first-level troubleshooting, diagnosis, and resolution of technical incidents and service requests. Escalate unresolved issues to second-level support, third-level support, or Federal staff as appropriate. Track customer issues throughout the ticket lifecycle and provide timely status updates to stakeholders. Confirm customer satisfaction and ensure proper documentation before ticket closure. Support employee onboarding activities by configuring workstations and facilitating required network access. Perform user account administration activities, including account creation, password resets, identity verification, and account maintenance. Staff the Service Desk during established operating hours and provide responsive customer support. Utilize knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting documentation to deliver consistent service. Complete service requests and incident response activities within established service level agreements (SLAs). Conduct all customer interactions in a professional, courteous, and service-oriented manner. Additional Assigned and Shared Duties Perform routine account creation, suspension, and termination activities in coordination with Systems Administrators. Support expedited account suspension and access removal actions when directed by OST Federal personnel. Assist with maintaining knowledge base articles and support documentation. Support inventory tracking and workstation deployment activities. Participate in process improvement initiatives that enhance Service Desk operations and customer satisfaction. Collaborate with infrastructure and cybersecurity teams to ensure compliance with operational and security requirements. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: High School diploma/equivalent and 3 years of experience. Must be a U.S. Citizen. Must be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q Clearance; work is performed within a DOE Limited Area. Foundational knowledge of IT service management principles and ticketing systems. Basic troubleshooting experience supporting Windows desktops, Microsoft 365 applications, printers, and network connectivity issues. Strong customer service, verbal communication, and written communication skills. Ability to follow established procedures, processes, and security requirements. Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented customer support environment. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer requests simultaneously. Preferred Qualifications: Experience using ServiceNow. ITIL Foundation, CompTIA A+, or similar industry certification. Experience performing Active Directory account administration. Experience supporting Federal Government customers or classified environments. Familiarity with Microsoft 365 administration and endpoint support.
